title: Page 9
content_zh:
世界崩毁了，她最深沉的恶梦实现了。
早该知道的不是吗？等他恢复记忆，他会想起当时提出分手的理由，当初他不能忍受她的理由，然后就无法忍受她，然后就记起了他正牌的女朋友……
这些她早就意料到了，所以才不许自己被他的苦苦纠缠、他的甜言蜜语所迷惑，心软。但结果呢？
笨呵！蠢呵！傻呵！
活该她现在要一个人躲在这里哭。
想到这里，她的泪停了，只是怔怔的看着车窗外，有种放弃一切的空洞。
“小姐，到了。停这就好了吗？”
“嗯。”她付了车钱，下车。
站在他家门口，看着昨天还认真考虑着要搬过来的房子，不是不心酸的，可是她勉强把注意力集中在来这里的目的上。
用颤抖的手拿出备用钥匙拿东西。
是的，她是来把东西从他家拿走的，那样的话，当他要提出分手的时候，她可以潇洒的对他说“好”、“没问题”。
即使让同一个男人抛弃两次，至少仅有的尊严她还是要的。
从衣柜里拿出所有属于她的衣服，随即塞进行李袋里，接着她走进浴室。那里她的牙刷、漱口杯跟他的并排在一起，毛巾也是相同款式不同颜色的两条相亲相爱黏在一起。
要将它们分开就像是把自己的心撕成两半一样痛苦，眼泪又再度不争气的模糊了视线。
她用水拍了拍红肿的眼，再抬头看着镜子里的自己。
一张哭得凄惨的脸能有多好看？可是这张脸，却好几次说可爱。
我爱你……喜欢你……
催眠般的言语他在她耳边说了无数次，说得她都相信了。没有人曾经那么爱过她，也没有人曾经告诉她她是特别的，她是值得被爱的。
跟他交往的时候她一直战战兢兢，不敢放太多感情，她很害怕！
人生第一次的恋爱，来得那样猛烈，让人措手不及。还没来得及品尝那仿佛将人整个席卷而入的幸福，她的反应竟是害怕。

【本段不纯洁的描写已删减，万分抱歉】
不可能再有人家他这样，给她那么强烈的感觉，也给她那么浓烈的感情。失去了他，她的人生将只剩不可怕的空洞。寂寞孤独她并不陌生，在遇见他以前她的生活就是那样的。只是，跟他交往过后，她已经无法再忍受那样的生活。
他改变了她。
范蕙怡猛然领悟了一点——她已经无法再缩回那层保护自己的硬壳，因为她已经变得贪心、想要更多。
咚咚、咚咚……她仿佛听到心脏擂动的声响。
她不甘心就这么失去，所以呢？她是不是该做些什么努力？
害怕被拒绝？害怕受挫？那又怎样呢？再遭也比不过失去他的痛苦。
镜中的女人眼里升起了一股坚定，那是刚刚那个沮丧失神的女人所没有的光彩，看起来似乎……比较耀眼？
也许，这样的她并不是完全没有机会。
想到这里，她吞了口口水，她决定了——不再不战而逃。
她继续收拾自己的东西，不过这回不再哭丧着脸。
第9章(2)
范蕙怡下定决心的同时，公司里却已经乱成一团，徐士凯发现她不见的时候简直快疯了。
她的手机没开，他冲到她家，没人在，再冲回家，发现她把所有私人物品全都带走了，他整个人好像掉进冰窖里。
那傻女人！到底在胡思乱想什么？
正急得如热锅上的蚂蚁，手机响起来，看到来电的人是她的时候，他因为突来的释然而差点虚脱。
“你跑到哪去了？”他知道自己的语气是冲了点，但他实在控制不住。
“对不起。”
手机里传来她迟疑的声音，听到对不起三个字的时候他的心往下沉。
“你在哪里？我去接你。”

“在家。”
“怎么可能？我有派人守在那里看你有没有回去。”
似乎没想到他会这么做，手机那头的她沉默了一会儿才说：“正确来说是我快到家了，我有事想跟你说，可以请你过来一趟吗？”
“你等我！我马上到！不准再给我乱跑了，懂吗？”
他说完就切断通讯。
他的反应让范蕙怡有些出乎意料之外，首先她不知道他会急着找她，然后他的语气也不如她想像的冷漠，反而像是此她还急着跟她谈似的。
他想谈什么？分手吗？
无论如何她的决心不会改变，她会把自己想说的话勇敢的说出来，不管结果如何，至少没有遗憾。
她走进家门，静静的坐着等待。
没有几分钟他就已经出现在门口，气喘吁吁的模样显示他有多急着来见她。
徐士凯本来已经打算好了一见到她就要好好骂她一顿，可是门一
范蕙怡换了个发型，蓬松轻盈的秀发缠绕在她小巧的脸蛋旁边，让她整个人没了严肃，多了份甜美。让人产生距离感的眼镜没了，显露出一双水汪汪的大眼睛。
她常穿的深色套装也神奇的消失了，身上粉色的针织衫跟雪纺纱裙令人迫不及待的想把她抱进怀里，尽情品尝那柔软的触感跟底下玲珑有致的身体。
尽管如此，他还是不敢置信。“你失踪了快一整天，就是去剪头发？”
不只那样，还有隐形眼镜、买新衣服……范蕙怡紧张的吞口口水，不过她没有详细解释，只想趁着还有勇气的时候把该说的话都说出来。
“那不重要，请你专心听我接下来要讲的话。”
徐士凯狐疑的眯起眼，范蕙怡则低头看脚尖。
“你恢复记忆了，我知道你已经想起我们分手的事情，也记起不想跟我在一起的原因，也许现在你正想着怎么跟我再提一次。”
他皱眉。“我——”
“请先不要说！听我说。”她打断了他。“我非常胆小，害怕自己会受伤，所以一直不敢放太多感情下去。你对我很好，很有耐心的等待着这个懦弱的我，让我第一次知道爱人跟被爱是什么感觉，让我经历了一段比任何想像都要美好的爱情。”

徐士凯脸孔扭曲了起来。他不喜欢她用那种过去式的语气来形容他们的关系。
但当他想要说些什么的时候，看到她涨红了脸，然后眼泪大颗大颗的从那双迷蒙的双眼中滚落，她一时心疼得什么话都说不出来。
范蕙怡勉强克制住哽咽才能继续说下去。
“想起我们在一起的点点滴滴，我才领悟到，其实我根本没有做过任何努力。
我对自己的外表没有信心，可能也没有尝试着改变；我觉得自己的个性太不让人喜欢，可是也没有试过要坦率勇敢一点。
其实我是自私的，怕你会抛弃我、厌倦我，所以就一直逃避。可是现在我想改变了——”
她深吸了一口气，才勇敢的抬头。
“我想说的是，谢谢你那样包容我、爱我，我知道自己配不上你，但是……我还是想跟你在一起，不管时间长短都没关系，只要在你厌倦我以前能够在一起就好了。”
徐士凯瞪着她，久久都没有回应，随着时间过去，范蕙怡的心也渐渐往下坠落。
果然……还是不行。
算了，至少她做过努力，也诚实说出自己的心情。即使这么安慰自己，可是巨大的沮丧还是压垮了她。
她低下头。
羞耻感冲刷着她，她的头更低了，恨不得自己消失不见。
“嗯……对不起，跟你说了这些……没关系，我知道了，在你那里的东西我已经都拿回来了，所以……所以就这样吧，请你离开。”她神经紧绷的等待着他离去的脚步声响起，但许久过后，依然没有，终于她忍不住抬头了。“你到底——”
content_en:
The world fell apart and her worst nightmare came true.
You should have known earlier, right? When he regains his memory, he will remember the reason why he broke up with her at that time. He couldn't stand her reason at first, then he couldn't stand her, and then he remembered his real girlfriend...
She had expected this a long time ago, so she didn't allow herself to be deceived by his pestering and sweet words, and she became soft-hearted. But the result?
Stupid! Stupid! Silly!
She deserved it, and now she had to hide here alone and cry.
Thinking of this, her tears stopped, and she just looked out the car window blankly, feeling like she had given up everything.
"Miss, we're here. Can we just stop here?"
"Yeah." She paid the fare and got out of the car.
Standing in front of his house, looking at the house that she had seriously considered moving to yesterday, it was not without sadness, but she could barely focus on the purpose of coming here.
With trembling hands, I took out the spare key and took out the things.
Yes, she came to take things away from his house, so that when he wanted to break up, she could say "ok" and "no problem" to him calmly.
Even if she is abandoned by the same man twice, at least she still wants the dignity she has.
She took out all her clothes from the closet, stuffed them into her duffel bag, and walked into the bathroom. Her toothbrush and mouthwash cup were placed side by side with his, and two towels of the same style and different colors were stuck together.
Separating them was as painful as tearing my heart in half, and tears blurred my vision again.
She dabbed her red and swollen eyes with water, then looked up at herself in the mirror.
How beautiful can a face that is crying miserably be? But this face has been called cute many times.
I love you...like you...
He said the hypnotic words in her ears countless times, until she believed them. No one had ever loved her that much, and no one had ever told her that she was special and worthy of love.
When she was dating him, she was always trepidatious and didn't dare to show too much emotion. She was very scared!
The first love in life was so violent that it caught people off guard. Before she had time to taste the happiness that seemed to sweep her away, her reaction was fear.
[The impure description in this paragraph has been deleted, I am extremely sorry]
It was impossible for anyone else to give her such a strong feeling and such strong emotions like him. Without him, her life would be left with nothing but a terrible void. She was no stranger to loneliness, her life had been like that before she met him. However, after dating him, she could no longer bear that kind of life.
He changed her.
Fan Huiyi suddenly realized something - she could no longer retract the hard shell that protected herself because she had become greedy and wanted more.
Dong dong, dong dong... She seemed to hear the beating of her heart.
She is not willing to lose like this, so what? Should she make some effort?
Afraid of rejection? Afraid of frustration? So what? Nothing could compare to the pain of losing him.
There was determination in the eyes of the woman in the mirror, which was a brilliance that the depressed and absent-minded woman just now didn't have. She seemed...more dazzling?
Maybe, she doesn't have no chance at all.
Thinking of this, she swallowed her saliva and decided not to run away without a fight.
She continued to pack her things, but this time she no longer looked sad.
Chapter 9(2)
While Fan Huiyi made up her mind, the company was already in chaos. Xu Shikai went crazy when he found out that she was missing.
Her cell phone was not turned on, so he rushed to her house, but no one was there. When he rushed home, he found that she had taken away all her personal belongings, and he seemed to have fallen into an ice cellar.
That silly woman! What are you thinking about?
Just when she was as anxious as an ant on a hot pot, her cell phone rang, and when she saw that the caller was her,He almost collapsed from the sudden relief.
"Where have you been?" He knew his tone was a bit harsh, but he couldn't control it.
"I'm sorry."
Her hesitant voice came from the phone, and his heart sank when he heard the words "sorry."
"Where are you? I'll pick you up."
"At home."
"How is that possible? I sent people to guard there to see if you have returned."
As if she didn't expect him to do this, she was silent for a while on the other end of the phone before saying, "To be precise, I'm almost home. I have something to tell you. Can you please come over?"
"Wait for me! I'll be there soon! Don't let me run around anymore, do you understand?"
After he finished speaking, he cut off the communication.
His reaction was a bit unexpected to Fan Huiyi. First of all, she didn't know that he would be in a hurry to find her, and then his tone was not as cold as she expected. Instead, it seemed that she was in a hurry to talk to her.
What does he want to talk about? Break up?
No matter what, her determination will not change. She will bravely say what she wants to say. No matter what the result is, at least she will have no regrets.
She walked into the house and sat quietly waiting.
Within a few minutes he appeared at the door, panting showing how anxious he was to see her.
Xu Shikai had already planned to scold her as soon as he saw her, but Men Yi
Fan Huiyi changed her hairstyle. Her fluffy and light hair was wrapped around her small face, making her look less serious and more sweet. The glasses that made people feel distant were gone, revealing a pair of big watery eyes.
The dark suit she usually wore also magically disappeared. The pink sweater and chiffon skirt on her body made people want to hold her in their arms and savor the soft touch and the exquisite body underneath.
Still, he couldn't believe it. "You were missing for almost a whole day, just to get your hair cut?"
Not only that, but also contact lenses, buying new clothes... Fan Huiyi swallowed nervously, but she did not explain in detail, she just wanted to say what she needed to say while she still had the courage.
"That's not important. Please pay attention to what I'm going to say next."
Xu Shikai narrowed his eyes suspiciously, while Fan Huiyi lowered her head and looked at her toes.
"You have recovered your memory. I know you have remembered our breakup and why you didn't want to be with me. Maybe now you are thinking about how to mention it to me again."
He frowned. "I——"
"Please don't say it yet! Listen to me." She interrupted him. "I am very timid and afraid that I will get hurt, so I have never dared to let go of too much emotion. You were very kind to me and patiently waited for this cowardly me, letting me know for the first time what it feels like to love and be loved, and let me experience a love that is better than anything I could have imagined."
Xu Shikai's face twisted. He didn't like the past tense tone she used to describe their relationship.
But when he wanted to say something, he saw her face flushed and tears rolling down from her misty eyes. She was so distressed that she couldn't say anything.
Fan Huiyi barely restrained herself from choking before she could continue.
"Thinking of every moment we were together, I realized that I actually didn't make any effort at all.
I have no confidence in my appearance, and I may not have tried to change it; I feel that my personality is too unpleasant, but I have not tried to be more frank and brave.
In fact, I am selfish. I am afraid that you will abandon me and get tired of me, so I keep avoiding you. But now I want to change—"
She took a deep breath before bravely raising her head.
"What I want to say is, thank you for tolerating me and loving me like that. I know I'm not worthy of you, but... I still want to be with you. It doesn't matter how long it takes, as long as we can be together before you get tired of me."
Xu Shikai stared at her, there was no response for a long time. As time passed, Fan Huiyi's heart gradually fell.
Sure enough... it still doesn't work.
Forget it, at least she made an effort and told her feelings honestly. Even though she comforted herself in this way, the huge depression still overwhelmed her.
She lowered her head.
Shame washed over her, her head dropped lower, wishing she could disappear.
"Well... I'm sorry for telling you this... It doesn't matter. I know. I have got everything back from your place, so... So that's it, please leave." She nervously waited for the sound of his leaving footsteps, but after a long time, there was still no sound. Finally, she couldn't help but look up. "What on earth are you——"
